title: Hanasato Minori — Wh-Wh-Wh-What?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to begin our trial video shoot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem excited.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I am because we're finally doing idol stuff as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! So let's start already!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Just let me set up the tablet first...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness. You fixed it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Did something happen to that tablet?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah... Um... Well, yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, let's try filming something!
Ready, start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's recording, so you can move now.
And if you could say something...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm so sorry... I'm just not sure what I should be doing for the video is all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, r-right!
We have to decide on something to do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm. Maybe for this test, we can take a video of the self-introduction I use for my auditions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, could you be the cameraman and film me instead?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sure, of course.
I just have to take a video of you, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... How do I do that with this...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There should be a red circle towards the bottom. Just tap it lightly and all you need to do after that is hold the camera up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Red circle... Oh, this one!
Tap it lightly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Shizuku! I think your finger's covering the lens. Could you move your right hand down a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see, move my right hand down...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! You need to take your hand off the screen too...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? The screen changed into something else...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha, it registered that as a swipe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, if you move your fingers while they're still on the screen, it'll react to them, so you need to take your hand off first...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear... It keeps making these clicking sounds too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yikes! The camera app switched to burst mode!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... I just have to remove my right hand. There.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... It should be fine now.... Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, there are so many different screens... What is this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku, your left hand!
Your fingers are pressing a bunch of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, then... I'll just hold it with my right hand...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! Wait, Shizuku! If you hold it like that, it'll happen all over again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is what happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I see...
That must've been quite an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hahaha, s-sorry for laughing, Minori, but that's what happens when you let Shizuku use anything electronic...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, it's not very nice to laugh!
We were both in a total panic then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But imagining the both of you scrambling around like that... It's a shame none of it ended up on video.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're so right! I wish I could see the faces you were both making then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... It's been a while since I laughed so hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We've been feeling lost and confused lately, laughing really cleared my mind. All thanks to you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Then laugh all you want, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, shall we go back to our video shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
